checkpointFailed: Recovery checkpoint could not save. Keep this page open and retry.
saveBusy: A save is already in progress.
enableBeforeSave: Enable this tool for the owner project before saving.
saveInterrupted: Save interrupted. Your draft is retained.
finishStock: Finish this stock operation, or use Cancel to discard it.
keepDraft: Keep or save the open draft before restoring this checkpoint.
recoveryUnavailable: This recovery operation is unavailable. Its checkpoint has been kept.
finishStockLeave: Finish or cancel the stock operation before leaving.
chooseExistingLocation: Choose an existing location from Projects.
enableTool: Enable this tool for its owner project in Preferences to open the saved item.
reviewChangesHelp: Changes to different fields are combined. Choose which version to keep for each conflicting field.
saveTransaction: Save item edits before recording an inventory transaction.
saveTransfer: Save the item before transferring it.
transferHelp: This moves existing stock. The total across all locations stays the same.

bomStockUse.one: BOM use from this stock: {used} used; {scrapped} scrapped in {count} completed BOM.
bomStockUse.other: BOM use from this stock: {used} used; {scrapped} scrapped in {count} completed BOMs.

taskEmpty: Plan work, assign names, keep checklists and connect prerequisites to your research.
bookingEmpty: Book equipment from Inventory. Conflicting reservations and maintenance are checked when saving.
daylightTime: This local time does not exist because of a daylight-saving change.
bookingTimes: Times shown in {zone}. Maintenance reserves the equipment's full capacity.
calendarEmpty: Create calendars for a location, team or shared work.
eventEmpty: Schedule work in one of your calendars.
subscriptionEmpty: Add a read-only HTTPS iCalendar subscription from another calendar service.
connectionEmpty: Combine calendars from another Observanda workspace that you can unlock.
name: Name
endDateHelp: The end date is the first day after the event.
subscriptionHelp: Read-only iCalendar (ICS). Refreshes while the calendar is open; private subscription URLs stay in this workspace.
calendarConnectionHelp: Save this connection, then unlock it from the calendar overview. Credentials are never saved here.
transactionChanged: This item changed while you were preparing the transaction. Nothing was transferred or consumed. Cancel this transaction, review the latest stock, then try again.
bomEmpty: Plan components for a prototype or run, reserve stock, then record actual use.
itemEmpty: Add owned equipment, materials, instruments or software. Receive stock centrally and allocate it to projects.
categoryEmpty: Define the fields your work needs. Existing resources retain the field version they were created with.
stockHelp: Use Stock & allocations to receive, transfer or consume stock.
placementHelp: Held at {location}. Use Placement to move this item.
saveBomEdits: Save or discard BOM edits before changing stock.
validQuantities: Enter valid quantities to calculate stock requirements.
bomPlanHelp: A component plan for one build or run. Saving a plan does not use stock.
componentChoiceHelp: Choose the exact inventory item and stock source for each populated line. Component values stay as written, such as 4k7 or 100 nF; no equivalence or substitution is assumed.
mappingRetained: The reviewed column mapping is retained. This plan may include later manual edits.
bomLineLimit: Up to 200 lines per BOM. Keep source BOMs and fabrication files in the linked record's Evidence & analysis.
saveBomFirst: Save the BOM before reserving components.
actualUseHelp: Enter what was actually fitted or used and what was scrapped. Remaining reserved parts return to availability at their original source. This does not mark the experiment successful.
reserveHelp: Reserve only after reviewing item choices, sources and quantities. All lines are reserved together.
reservedHelp: Components are reserved. Record actual use when finished, or cancel the build to release all parts.
allReleased: All reservations were released. No components were consumed.
buildFixed: Build status: {status}. This plan is fixed; use a copy for another revision or run.
chooseBomRecord: Choose the prototype / run record first. Import its original CSV or TSV in Evidence & analysis.
emptyDraftBom: Import into an empty draft BOM.
bomChanged: The BOM or workspace changed. Reopen import.
checkMapping: Check the suggested mapping, then review every component row.
importBomHelp: Choose an original CSV or TSV retained in the record's Evidence & analysis. Review columns before adding components. The original bytes stay unchanged.
componentReviewHelp: Inventory items and stock sources remain unassigned. Quantities use decimal notation; component values are kept as written. Reference ranges are expanded. New lines can be edited before saving.
noDnp: No DNP column mapped: all included rows will be populated.
noExclusion: No exclusion column mapped: no source rows will be excluded.
reviewedBom: I reviewed the column mapping, quantities, DNP and exclusions.
unmappedColumns: Columns retained only in the original: {columns}.
originalVerified: Original verified: {name} / {size} bytes. No stock changes.
fileSizeLimit: Choose a file between 1 byte and 256 KiB.
balanceFirst: Balance atoms and charge before calculating yields.
amountsFirst: Enter every reactant amount to calculate the limiting reagent.
sheetSizeLimit: Use up to 1,000 rows, 32 columns and 20,000 cells, with 2,000 characters per cell.
sheetRowLimit: The sheet reached its row or cell limit.
sheetColumnLimit: The sheet reached its column or cell limit.
calculationTimeout: Calculation exceeded the time limit. Simplify the expression or use a smaller table.
engineLoadFailed: The calculation engine could not load. Reload to retry.
sheetResultsHelp: Calculated cells update below their expressions. Empty and text cells are not treated as zero.
reactionHelp: Enter a balanced equation, then measured reactant amounts. A product amount means the actual amount recovered. Leave unmeasured amounts empty.
molarMassHelp: Molar masses use CIAAW 2024 abridged standard atomic weights. These calculations do not establish purity, measurement accuracy or reaction completeness. Charge notation: SO4^2-.
sheetHelp: Enter text and exact numeric values, or start a formula with =. Examples: =A1*2 and =SUM(A1:A5). Imported formulas stay literal text until you edit them.
csvHelp: CSV downloads retain cell text; formulas open as text.
chemicalHelp: Previews are derived from the editable source above. Download original retrieves the unchanged imported bytes. CDXML previews support molecular fragments; annotations and unsupported features remain in the original drawing.
toolEmpty: Create a {type} and link it to the work it supports.
